todos.title: Start German citizenship application
todos.notes: Address: Schießgartenstraße 3, Götzenhain (Stadtteil of Dreieich), Kreis Offenbach. Married to German citizen. 10+ years residency (far exceeds 3-year minimum for spouses). B1 certificate and naturalization test already completed. Application goes via Kreisverwaltung Offenbach to Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt. Contact: Fachdienst Ausländerangelegenheiten, Werner-Hilpert-Str. 1, Dietzenbach, Tel: 06074 8180-1347. Fee: €255 adult. Timeline: 18-24 months processing.

subtasks.title: Contact Kreis Offenbach Ausländerbehörde (06074 8180-1347) to confirm process and book appointment
Gather core documents: valid UK passport, German residence permit (Aufenthaltstitel), UK birth certificate with certified translation
Gather marriage certificate (Heiratsurkunde) proving marriage to German citizen
Gather financial documents: payslips (last 6 months), employment contract, rental contract
Gather proof of health insurance (Krankenversicherung)
Locate B1 German language certificate (already completed)
Locate naturalization test certificate (already completed)
Prepare CV in German (Lebenslauf) with residency timeline
Complete application form (Antrag auf Einbürgerung)
Submit application with all documents at Kreisverwaltung appointment
Pay application fee: €255
Wait for processing by Regierungspräsidium Darmstadt (18-24 months)
Receive Einbürgerungsurkunde (naturalization certificate) at Rathaus Dreieich
